newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stock market bullish on dollar strength.
newsitem.headline: Norway stock market bullish on dollar strength.

text.p: Norwegian shares, led by industrial giant Norsk Hydro, soared to an all-time high on Wednesday boosted by a strong dollar and a rally on overseas markets.
Oslo's Total index ended 1.37 percent up at 1,264.58 points for a record close. Turnover was moderate at 792 million crowns.
A 0.25 percentage point rise in official interest rates by the Norwegian central bank failed to dampen the market.

"We thought the rate hike would act as a brake, but we only thought so for half an hour," one broker said. "The dollar is strong. Europe is up. Unless there is a correction abroad there will not be a correction here either."
Hydro, which will present first-half results on Monday, rose three percent to a record 414 crowns and was the most traded share at 136 million crowns.
"There are many small buyers in Hydro today and at the same time many large Norwegian investors have already sold over the past few weeks, so there's generally a lack of sellers," one broker said.
A Reuter poll of nine analysts forecast first-half pre-tax profits of 6.09 billion crowns for Hydro, slightly down from 6.14 billion crowns a year ago.
